quests.title: The Window Above Randwick
quests.blurb: 29 years above Randwick. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since a wet Monday the joins sound different.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Marayong
quests.blurb: 8 years in the Marayong market. The bays are not allocated, they are *known*, and since a wet Monday somebody has decided that knowing does not count, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$34 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Loftus
quests.blurb: Somebody set the Loftus clock that way on purpose and everyone who knows why is nearly gone. The old crew drink near Sutherland on the week of the show. Go and ask, and they keep sending a different bloke.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Sutherland, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at The Star
quests.blurb: A dog meets the 5:40 at The Star every weekday and nobody gets off for it. Four months of this. I have decided it is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Marrickville
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the half six out of Marrickville runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$36 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Mount Kuring-gai
quests.blurb: Nothing runs out of Mount Kuring-gai after ten past five. I lock this end and somebody s mum locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Mount Colah and bring me a photograph of that.

steps.label: ride the late one to Mount Colah
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Arlington Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Arlington at quarter to six and never taps off. Same card, 15 months running. Ride the run they ride and find where a person gets off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Gosford Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Gosford. Since Thursdays they have not turned up, and it has been like that since the merge. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Gosford kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $31 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Childrens Hospital
quests.blurb: Nobody upstairs believes me about Childrens Hospital because I have 12 years and no data. Go and stand on that platform on school holidays and get me the data, and I am past being reasonable about it.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Como

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$29 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Wentworth Park
quests.blurb: The quiet carriage runs on shame and somebody on the quarter to six out of Wentworth Park has stopped feeling it. Ride it, see the crime, and apply the shame manually.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Circular Quay Shortcut
quests.blurb: Nine minutes between the shortcut at Circular Quay and the long way, and nine minutes is four drops. Since the first of the month there has been a padlock on it, and nobody will put it in writing.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$41, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Convention
quests.blurb: Third time at Convention on the week of the show. Not kids — kids run. This one walks, and it has been like that since the merge. I need it stopped before somebody writes a very long report about me.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Kingsgrove Regular
quests.blurb: Same stool since before I bought the place off Kingsgrove road. Gone since every second Friday, and I have stopped filling in the form. I would like to know whether to keep the stool.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Lilyfield
quests.blurb: Two hundred bays at Lilyfield and I have counted two hundred and forty cars in here on the first of the month. One of them has not moved since March and it has a ticket on it from March.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$23 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Canterbury
quests.blurb: One colour, grey, the same grey in Canterbury as in every other suburb. I would like something of this one to exist afterwards, and nobody will put it in writing.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Guildford
quests.blurb: I drive past the same view above Guildford eleven times a shift and I have never once stopped at it. You have got legs and no timetable. Go up and photograph what I have been driving past for 10 years.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$32, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Casula
quests.blurb: Two hundred and eighty-five dollars at Casula for a thing the sign did not say, because the sign is not there. The form wants evidence. Go and photograph the absence.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Berowra

photograph it while it still exists
